title: A new /start lead who ticks the box is asked to confirm, so persona nurture can start

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: /start enrolls a lead in nurture only when the address is already subscribed (app/(marketing)/start/actions.ts:139-142, SCAN-1216 made that safe). Nothing asks a new lead to confirm, so a new /start persona lead never reaches its nurture series. Fix: when consent is unknown and the box is ticked, send the double opt-in (requestOptin / sendOptinConfirmEmail) and enroll on confirm, as /subscribe does.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
